results.claim: Mentions that some expense lines were zero in Jun 2026 after being non-zero in prior months, naming at least two of: Advisory Services, Federal & State Taxes, Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous, Professional Fees.
results.evidence: The commentary says "Federal & State Taxes ... and Marketing/Advertising: Miscellaneous ... are zero in Jun 2026", and it gives prior averages for both, so they were non-zero before. That names two of the listed lines.

results.claim: Every figure given for those lines' prior averages (individually or as a range) satisfies the rounding policy. If no such figures are given, this claim PASSES.
results.evidence: It gives "prior 6-month average 999" for Federal & State Taxes, against a true 998.5083 (about 0.05% off). It gives "average 721" for Marketing Misc, against a true 721.0033 (about 0.0005% off). Both are well inside the 5% band.

results.claim: States as fact a reason those lines went to zero (e.g. contract ended, cost cutting, vendor dropped).
results.evidence: No cause is stated for the zeros. The commentary only says "Whether these are discontinued or timing is for the reviewer to confirm."

results.claim: Describes those lines as permanently discontinued or cancelled without leaving it to the reviewer.
results.evidence: It does not call the lines permanently discontinued or cancelled. It explicitly leaves "discontinued or timing" to the reviewer.
